incidents.reportText: Observed significant H2S leak from the casing head spool flange at Wellhead WH-44. The primary seal appears to have failed completely during pressure testing, and crew were working in the immediate vicinity without breathing apparatus.
While tripping pipe on Workover Rig #12, the monkey board monkey was seen bypassing the fall protection harness while reaching for the elevators. This is a severe fall risk from height.
Noticed minor corrosion on the Flare System Knockout Drum support struts during routine rounds. The coating is flaking but structural integrity seems okay for now.
Housekeeping issue at GGS-2 Plant control room entrance. Muddy boots left outside without proper cleaning, creating a slight slip hazard.
Annular BOP on Drilling Rig DR-03 failed to close completely during the blowout drill. Hydraulic pressure dropped unexpectedly, indicating a severe leak in the closing line.
Electrician was observed working on the Subsurface ESP Pump surface controller without implementing proper LOTO procedures. The main breaker was off but no lock was applied.
At Central Gathering Facility, the PSV on the test separator was found isolated with the block valve closed during normal operation. This removes overpressure protection.
Drill crew conducted a successful T-BOP test on DR-03, all parameters within spec. Good communication observed between driller and mud logger.
Catastrophic failure of the heater treater burner block at GGS Plant 01 resulting in a flash fire. Fire suppression system activated late due to a bypassed heat detector.
Found Separator Vessel 04 level control valve stuck in the open position. Liquid carryover to the gas line almost occurred before manual intervention.
Minor seepage of crude observed from a flanged connection on the Crude Export Flowline. The drip pan captured the few drops, no environmental impact.
Walkway gratings near GGS Plant 01 cooling towers are clear and recently painted. Handrails are secure. Good general condition.
Dropped object incident on Offshore Platform Alpha. A 50lb shackle fell from Deck Crane #02 during a lift, landing inches from a roustabout on the main deck. Crane limit switch failed.
Subsea Manifold Block choke valve actuator is showing erratic pressure readings on the ROV display. Suspect hydraulic leak in the umbilical tie-in, risking loss of well control.
Crew found missing kickboards on the temporary scaffolding erected near Offshore Platform Alpha flare boom. Risk of dropped tools to the deck below.
Routine inspection of lifeboats on Offshore Platform Alpha completed. Davits lubricated and engines started on first crank. Ready for emergency use.

workerNarratives.narrative: I was checking the wellhead pressure and suddenly heard a loud hiss. The flange seal blew out and H2S alarms went off. We had to evacuate immediately.
Saw a heavy pipe wrench fall from the derrick while they were tripping in. It hit the rig floor hard, right next to the driller's cabin.
The separator pressure gauge was spiking above normal operating limits. Noticed the PSV block valve had been closed by mistake by the previous shift.
The guy working on the crane motor didn't have his harness tied off properly. He was leaning way over the handrail over the water.
Found some oily rags left near the flare knockout drum. Picked them up and put them in the proper bin to keep the area clean.
Just doing my rounds and noticed the walkway gratings on the lower deck were looking a bit rusty but still solid. Logged it for future maintenance.
